rationale: Reallocated the fp16 export budget inside the winning reverse-tail recurrent family: recurrent tail blocks now keep K/V in float instead of Q/K, and the last block explicitly keeps Q/V. This is a compact, compile-stable export-side change aimed at the local near-miss signal around recurrent-tail value-path rescue while avoiding another broad structural rewrite.
title: Reverse-Tail KV Float Rescue
